(.venv/bin/python tools/repro_f2.py)': the response names the script the new command runs (`tools/repro_f2.py`) and describes it, but never shows the command string. Stricter reading applied (the command itself must appear in the response): FAIL. A2, 'says that nothing was run because of it': the response says the recheck and the script were not run because of the rule, and that the review's tests were then run by hand. Per the round owner's rule, manual test runs outside the recorded-commands mechanism do not by themselves fail an assertion, so this half is read as 'none of the recorded commands was run through the recheck' and is met.
